integrity: The proof derives exact covariance eigenvalues and a unique optimal two-orbit mixing parameter, proves all-vertex contact analytically, and supplies a global determinant certificate. Finite decimal tests corroborate but do not replace the proof.
limitations: Does not cover arbitrary rank-two matroids with multiple nontrivial parallel classes, higher-rank matroids, noncanonical affine metrics, or John ellipsoids. Unindexed prior equivalent results cannot be ruled out.
scientific_scope: Connected rank-two matroid base polytopes with exactly one nontrivial parallel class of size a>=2 and b>=2 singleton classes; intrinsic Euclidean affine metric.
title: The exact Löwner ellipsoid of a single-class rank-two matroid base polytope
